description: Reload a running extension's background context, or a tab. Rides the dev session's control channel, on unless extension_dev was called with allowControl:false. A background reload answers once the engine's ready.json shows the new background attached to the dev server again (value.reattached, value.reattachedMs), so the next read or assertion meets the new generation and not the gap between them; if it has not come back within the budget (timeout, at most 5 seconds) the answer is status reloading with the contract's own stamps.

browser.description: Session browser; defaults to this project's live session. Required when the project runs sessions for more than one browser: the call is refused with the list rather than picking one.

projectPath.description: Extension project root (needs a live dev session)

tab.description: For content/page: a specific tab id

timeout.description: Command timeout in ms. When omitted, the default depends on the route: 30000 through the dev session's control channel, 10000 over the Firefox debugger protocol, and 15000 per command over the Chromium debug port.

name: extension_reload
